specs.Minimum Required Operating System Versio: Mac OS 10.12 Sierra, Ubuntu 16.04 Xenial Xerus, Windows 10

features: DUAL MODE CONNECTIVITY: Supports 2.4GHz wireless with USB nano receiver and Bluetooth mode, allowing easy connection to multiple devices with a simple mode switch.
ADJUSTABLE DPI CONTROL: Offers up to 2400 DPI with 3-level DPI switch (1000 / 1600 / 2400) and indicator for smooth tracking and precise cursor control.
RECHARGEABLE BATTERY: Built-in rechargeable battery with Type-C charging support eliminates the need for frequent battery replacements.
6-BUTTON FUNCTIONALITY: Equipped with 6 responsive buttons, including left, right, scroll, and additional controls for better productivity and convenience.
SILENT & PRECISE PERFORMANCE: Designed for quiet clicks with high-precision tracking that works smoothly on most surfaces.
